learningPaths.title: Python
learningPaths.description: Learn Python from the ground up: how variables and objects really work, control flow, and functions — with a deep dive into scope and closures.

learningPaths.title: ReactJS
learningPaths.description: Build a solid JavaScript foundation in scope, hoisting, and closures, then learn how React components and JSX turn that foundation into declarative UI.

learningPaths.title: Java
learningPaths.description: Static typing, the JVM, and object-oriented fundamentals through the language that still runs most of the enterprise world.

learningPaths.title: Spring Boot
learningPaths.description: Build production Java web services and REST APIs with the framework behind most enterprise Java backends.

learningPaths.title: Node.js
learningPaths.description: Server-side JavaScript: the event loop, npm ecosystem, and building APIs outside the browser.

learningPaths.title: Go
learningPaths.description: A statically-typed, compiled language built for simplicity and concurrency — goroutines, channels, and a famously small spec.

learningPaths.title: Databases & PostgreSQL
learningPaths.description: Relational modeling, SQL in depth, indexing, transactions, and how PostgreSQL specifically implements all of it.

learningPaths.title: Vector Databases
learningPaths.description: Embeddings, similarity search, and how vector databases like Pinecone power retrieval for AI applications.

learningPaths.title: AI & Machine Learning
learningPaths.description: Core ML concepts — from what a model actually is, through training/evaluation, to where deep learning fits in.

learningPaths.title: LLM Engineering
learningPaths.description: Practical large language model engineering: prompting, context windows, RAG, fine-tuning, and building reliable AI features.

learningPaths.title: Docker & Containers
learningPaths.description: Package and run applications consistently anywhere — images, containers, volumes, and Dockerfiles from first principles.

learningPaths.title: Kubernetes
learningPaths.description: Orchestrating containers at scale: pods, deployments, services, and the mental model behind declarative infrastructure.

learningPaths.title: System Design
learningPaths.description: Designing systems that scale: load balancing, caching, database scaling, and the tradeoffs behind every real architecture decision.

learningPaths.title: Cloud Architecture & AWS
learningPaths.description: Core cloud concepts through AWS specifically — compute, storage, networking, and how to reason about cost and reliability.

learningPaths.title: DevOps
learningPaths.description: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, monitoring, and the practices that connect writing code to running it reliably in production.
